WHY NOT A DIRECT LOOKUP: Get-HyVeeStoreProduct (pull-regular-hyvee.ps1:1334) reads $EP, $HDR and $script:HvRequest* set at lines 1298-1333 of that script, the Kroger path lives in pull-regular-bakers-api.ps1 (Get-KrogerToken/Get-KrogerJson over term searches) and Freshop's in pull-regular-familyfare.ps1 (a session token, then Get-FreshopItems by term). A verifier calling any of them would spend lookups OUTSIDE each lane's budget, which the rate-limit rule forbids, and Freshop answered HTTP 400 carrying error_code 429 to 102-115 lookups a day this week. So the re-read is the lane's own next read of that product, which comes out of its budget by construction, and a pending verification leads that lane's asks.
items.root_cause: The detector (sanity-check) is right to be sensitive and prices move every day, but its only consumer was a human: every flag became homework ('these still published; verify they are real'), so the channel fired on 22 of the 30 days ending 2026-09-21 however good each close was. Nothing in the estate turned a flag into the question it actually asks - is this the store's price for this product - although the pipeline re-reads every product it prices, and the store is the source of truth (Brad's standing ruling, .claude/rules/meal-prep.md 'EVERY PRICE IS FETCHED').

root_fix.what: verify each paging flag against the store's own LATER read of the same product and page only a disagreement. match closes the flag with no alert; wrong-price or wrong-product quarantines that ONE cell through the existing per-cell quarantine and pages ONE alert naming the cell, both prices and the store's product; could-not-look keeps it pending and the product leads that store's next capture inside the store's budget.
root_fix.exact_change: sanity-check: every flag also carries id, store, item, per_unit, unit, row_type, ad_from, ad_to, as_of of the cell it is about (outlier: the cheapest row; wow: the current cheapest row; native-mismatch: that row), detail unchanged. flag-verify-lib (pure): Get-TcFlagSubjects, Find-TcStoreReread (newest capture row of the same product - same product_id/item_id where the claim's source row carries one, else the same name - whose as_of is strictly later than the claim's read date and which is not carried/not_reverified), Resolve-TcRereadVerdict (identity: the commodity's OWN matcher entry over the store's item and its link-slug name, a name the commodity's own pattern admits and its own exclude then refuses is wrong-product; basis: every store reading of per-unit - shelf price over the size field, shelf price over the size the NAME states, the store's printed unit price - compared on integer keys, none agreeing with ours is wrong-price, some agreeing and some not is could-not-look; price: an everyday claim against the store's current shelf price in integer cents; a SALE claim is compared on price only when the store's read falls inside the claim's own ad window, and a read after the window can never be match), Update-TcFlagLedger (keyed <id>|<store> with the claim's key; only match settles; a claim that leaves the board or changes closes as left-board/claim-changed and is counted, never matched), Get-TcFlagVerifyOwed. verify-price-flags.ps1 writes out/flag-verification.json and prints the resolution per store with denominators and VERIFY-PRICE-FLAGS-COMPLETE. audit-flag-verification.ps1 prints QUARANTINE-CELL <id>|<store>|value for every open disagreement whose claim is still the board's cell and exits 2 (0 clean, 3 blind), wired into guards.ps1's delegated list. check-ad-cycles: runs the verifier after sanity-check; outlier/wow/native-mismatch stop feeding the batch alert only when the verifier completed over TODAY's guards file; one Send-Alert per new disagreement ('Grocery: price disagreement - <commodity> at <store>'); a daily log line with the pending backlog and its oldest age; a page only when a pending verification is older than the capture-policy quarter. capture-policy-lib: Get-CaptureWorklist puts VerifyTerms (pending commodities of that store) at the head inside the allowance, like RulingTerms, and they empty themselves as the ledger closes.

items.deviation: Narrower than the dispatch in three places, each on measurement. (i) No direct store lookup: the re-read is each lane's own next read of the product, because Get-HyVeeStoreProduct depends on the pull's script-scope endpoint, headers and request state and a verifier calling the lanes' fetches would spend lookups outside their budgets; instead a pending verification leads each lane's own asks inside its budget (Hy-Vee rank 0, Baker's -AdOwed, the Family Fare front, VerifyTerms at the head of Get-CaptureWorklist for the browser stores), so today's 26 flags resolve on the next captures, not today. (ii) The 'N NEW price flag(s)' type does not fully retire: the sanity kinds leave it whenever the verifier completed over that day's flags (fail closed otherwise), and its MULTIBUY, MATCHBLIND, BASIS and PACKBASIS lines still page there. (iii) The quarantine lands at the next guards run, not the same run: the verifier runs in the review unit after publish, a disagreement pages at once, and audit-flag-verification.ps1 names the cell to guards at the next build.
